frontmatter.title: What Are Containers? Understanding the Role of Containers, VMs, and Bare Metal in Modern Software Deployment
frontmatter.subheading: Demystifying Containers: A Comprehensive Guide to Understanding Why Containers Have Revolutionized Software Deployment
frontmatter.excerpt: Confused about containers, VMs, and bare metal? This blog post explains what containers are, why they are essential in modern software deployment, and how they compare to Virtual Machines and bare-metal systems. We'll also delve into Docker and the Open Container Initiative (OCI) to give you a well-rounded understanding.
frontmatter.author: Paul Serban
